PATH_NOT_REPO.title: This is not a Git repository
PATH_NOT_REPO.hint: Check the path, or initialise a repository in this directory first.

GIT_CONFLICT.title: There are unresolved conflicts
GIT_CONFLICT.hint: Resolve them on the Conflicts screen and continue, or abort to return to the previous state.

AUTH_REQUIRED.title: Sign-in required
AUTH_REQUIRED.hint: Connect your hosting account in Settings, or configure an access token for this remote.

AUTH_EXPIRED.title: Credential is no longer valid
AUTH_EXPIRED.hint: The token may have expired or been revoked. Sign in again and retry.

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Permission denied
PERMISSION_DENIED.hint: The current account or system user may not perform this action. Check token scopes or file permissions.

NOT_FOUND.title: Target not found
NOT_FOUND.hint: It may have been deleted or renamed. Refresh the list and try again.

VALIDATION.title: Invalid input
VALIDATION.hint: Check what you entered (for example, a branch name cannot contain spaces).

NETWORK.title: Network request failed
NETWORK.hint: Check your connection or proxy settings and retry; offline you can still work on local changes.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Host rate limit reached
RATE_LIMITED.hint: Try again later, or reduce how many requests run at once.

PATCH_APPLY_FAILED.title: Patch could not be applied
PATCH_APPLY_FAILED.hint: The file may have changed. Refresh the state and select the lines to stage again.

PLAN_STALE.title: The plan is stale
PLAN_STALE.hint: The repository changed after this plan was built. Refresh and confirm the operation again.

HOOK_REJECTED.title: Rejected by a Git hook
HOOK_REJECTED.hint: Read the hook output (often a commit-message check or a failing test), fix it and commit again.

PUSH_REJECTED.title: Push rejected (the remote has new commits)
PUSH_REJECTED.hint: Fetch/Pull first to bring the remote commits down; if you must overwrite, use force-with-lease (it shows the remote commit for confirmation).

EMPTY_COMMIT.title: Nothing to commit
EMPTY_COMMIT.hint: The index is empty, or the staged changes are identical to the last commit. Stage something first.

RESTORE_VERIFY_FAILED.title: Restore verification failed
RESTORE_VERIFY_FAILED.hint: The restored state does not match the snapshot. Review the details and bring the repository back to a safe state.

STORAGE.title: Local data could not be read or written
STORAGE.hint: Make sure the data directory is writable and there is free disk space, then retry. Restarting the app may help.

KEYRING_UNAVAILABLE.title: System credential store unavailable
KEYRING_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Make sure the OS credential service is running (Secret Service on Linux), or use another authentication method.

PTY_UNSUPPORTED.title: Built-in terminal is not supported on this platform
PTY_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Run commands in your system terminal against this repository; everything else still works.

UNSUPPORTED_BY_ENGINE.title: The current engine does not support this operation
UNSUPPORTED_BY_ENGINE.hint: This feature needs the system git CLI. Make sure git is installed and callable.

CANCELLED.title: Operation cancelled
CANCELLED.hint: It was stopped at your request and the repository was left untouched. You can start again any time.

INTERNAL.title: Internal error
INTERNAL.hint: This is unexpected. Expand the details and include them in your bug report.

unknownHint: Expand the details for the raw message and include it in your bug report.
actionFailed: That fix action failed; see the new notification.
